ShortDescription.Value: Beta physical-lane rules with native public-lane access, soft traffic preferences and closures.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — selective routing behavior remains partially verified.
WHAT IT DOES Edit rules for physical lanes of a selected carriageway. Internal routing representations are grouped by lateral cross-section position, not simply counted as lanes.
HOW TO USE Open Road Rules, select a road/carriageway, select a physical lane, then choose a supported preset. Reset Lane restores its captured defaults.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Public/Service Lane uses CS2's shared public-lane category; it is not bus-only. No Heavy Traffic and Local Bias are native soft preferences, not absolute bans. Close Lane/Close Road request closures, but existing routes can take time to clear. Observe newly routed traffic rather than assuming all existing vehicles disappear. The exact two-lane highlight and class-enforcement runtime matrix is not complete. No claim is made that Skyve has cleared its warning. Test in a disposable city.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.4.5-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Fixed lanes remaining closed after Reopen, restored custom speed on Reset Lane, and prevented unsupported presets from changing the displayed rule. Corrected settings registration and removed repeated per-owner city-wide repath scans.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
